description: This is a PHP source file defining the IndexController class for the Goteo web application. It handles the homepage logic, including fetching projects, stories, banners, footprints, and other related data to render the index view.

classes.name: IndexController
classes.description: Controller class for handling the homepage, extending DiscoverController, responsible for gathering data and rendering the index view.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller, sets database replica and cache, and theme.

methods.name: indexAction
methods.description: Handles the main index page request, fetches projects, stories, banners, footprints, stats, sponsors, and announcements, then returns the view response.

methods.name: getSponsors
methods.description: Retrieves sponsors grouped by their types.
